pin.title: How Much to Charge for a Lash Refill (3-Part Formula)
points: + a share of rent, insurance & apps

slides.title: Your refill price is probably a *guess*.
slides.sub: Check it with a 3-part formula. Takes 2 minutes.

slides.title: What does a 50-minute refill really cost you?
slides.answer: Not just lashes and glue. Your time and your fixed costs are in there too.

slides.mistake: Copying the price of the salon down the road.
slides.fix: Start from your minutes and your costs. Compare after.
slides.why: Their rent, speed and costs aren't yours.

slides.title: Charging less than that? You're *paying* to work.
slides.sub: Raise the price, or shorten the service.

slides.title: Check your refill price
slides.sub: Free Google Sheets calculator. Type your minutes and costs, it does the maths.
